query: Spain LOIA AI governance bill Proyecto de Ley Orgánica buen uso gobernanza inteligencia artificial expediente 121/000096 enmienda a la totalidad status BOCG July 2026
answer:
I've completed the research on Spain's LOIA AI governance bill (expediente 121/000096). Here's the summary of key findings:

## Bottom Line

**On the "enmienda a la totalidad" question:** No evidence was found in any accessible source that an enmienda a la totalidad (motion to reject/return) was presented against expediente 121/000096. The July 2026 enmiendas a la totalidad that surfaced in the news were for **other, unrelated bills** (autonomic financing reform, Código Penal reform) — not the AI governance bill.

**Confirmed tramitación timeline:**
- 26/05/2026 — Consejo de Ministros approval
- 28/05/2026 — Presented to Congreso
- 08/06/2026 — Calificado as organic-law bill
- 12/06/2026 — Published in BOCG Serie A núm. 97-1; assigned to Comisión de Economía, Comercio y Transformación Digital
- 30/06/2026 — Amendment deadline (plazo de enmiendas)

**Most recent recorded status:** committee amendment phase, with no subsequent ponencia/dictamen/Pleno events found in accessible sources.

**Important caveat:** The official congreso.es iniciativa page and the amendment-deadline table (cuadro_plazo_enmiendas_XV.pdf) returned HTTP 403 to automated retrieval. So these negatives should be read as "not found in accessible sources" rather than confirmed absences from the official record — a manual check of the official congreso.es page is recommended to definitively confirm the post-30/06/2026 state (whether enmiendas a la totalidad were registered, whether the deadline was extended, and whether BOCG 97-2 exists).

The full report with sources and structured data points has been recorded via the StructuredOutput tool.

key_facts: Expediente 121/000096 (XV Legislatura) is the Proyecto de Ley Orgánica para el buen uso y la gobernanza de la inteligencia artificial ('LOIA'), adapting Spain to EU Regulation 2024/1689.
Approved by Consejo de Ministros on 26/05/2026 and remitted to Congreso; presented 28/05/2026.
Calificado by the Mesa del Congreso on 08/06/2026 and designated as an organic-law bill (proyecto de ley orgánica).
Published in BOCG Serie A núm. 97-1 on 12/06/2026 and assigned to the Comisión de Economía, Comercio y Transformación Digital.
Amendment period (plazo de enmiendas) ran from 12/06/2026 with a deadline of 30/06/2026 (18:00).
No evidence was found in accessible sources of any enmienda a la totalidad / enmienda de devolución presented against expediente 121/000096 by Vox, PP, or any other group.
July 2026 enmiendas a la totalidad found in the news related to OTHER bills (autonomic financing reform, Código Penal reform), NOT the AI governance bill.
Most recent recorded tramitación event as of research: committee amendment phase in the Comisión de Economía, deadline 30/06/2026; no later BOCG publication (e.g., 97-2) located.
Official congreso.es iniciativa page and cuadro_plazo_enmiendas_XV.pdf returned HTTP 403, so negatives are 'not found in accessible sources' rather than confirmed absence.
Bill designates AESIA (A Coruña) as default supervisor and sole EU contact point, with sectoral enforcement by AEPD, CGPJ, Banco de España, and CNMV.
Sanctions regime: up to €35M or 7% global turnover (prohibited practices), €7.5M or 1% (serious), €500K or 0.5% (minor).
Transparency/deepfake-marking obligations align with EU AI Act Art. 50, applicable from 02/08/2026.
